title: Kaiserklamm Brandenberg
highlights: Historische Triftklamm, in der Kaiser Franz Joseph I. einst die Holztrift bestaunte
In den Fels gehauener, schmaler und gesicherter Steig direkt an tosenden Kaskaden
Spektakulaere Felsdurchbrueche und enge Schluchtpassagen der Brandenberger Ache
Traditionsreiches Kaiserhaus am Klammeingang mit Spielplatz und Tiroler Kueche
kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserklamm in Brandenberg is a historic natural monument featuring roaring waterfalls and trails carved straight into the rock.
beschreibung:
Imperial Natural Wonder in the Brandenbergtal

The Kaiserklamm is situated in the rear of the Brandenbergtal and owes its name to Kaiser Franz Joseph I., who visited this natural spectacle in the 19th century. Until the 20th century, the wild gorge was used for hazardous timber rafting, washing tree trunks downstream towards the valley.

Cliff Path Along the Rushing River

Today, a secure trail, partially blasted into the rock face, leads through the dramatically narrow ravine. Roaring whirlpools alternate with emerald-green pools. Near the entrance, the historic Kaiserhaus invites hikers to relax with hearty refreshments after their gorge excursion.
